Describes disk drive storage technology. It is unrelated to exclusive load/store or LR/SC.

grades.quote: ARM load-exclusive and store-exclusive instructions can likewise map onto their RISC-V LR and SC equivalents
grades.reason: Gives the ARM-to-RISC-V mapping directly. ARM Load-Exclusive maps to lr.w/d, Store-Exclusive maps to sc.w/d, and the acquire/release variants map to the .aqrl and .rl bits. This answers what the RISC-V analogue is. It does not spell out a lock example.

grades.quote: LR/SC behave as if the old value is brought up to the core, modified, and written back to memory, all while a reservation is held on that memory location.
grades.reason: Explains RISC-V LR/SC semantics, the mechanism that is the analogue of ARM exclusives. It covers reservations and when an SC may succeed. It never links LR/SC to ARM or to implementing a lock.
